title: Library panel: drag-to-stage, context menu, rename
description: Library panel gaps: (1) Symbols can only be placed via Insert menu or double-click — add drag from library item to stage (HTML5 drag-and-drop or mousedown+mousemove tracking) that creates a SymbolInstance at drop position; (2) Right-click context menu on library items: Rename, Duplicate, Delete, Properties, Edit (enters edit-in-place); (3) Library panel header sort (by name/type/use count); (4) Folder creation and item drag-into-folder in the library; (5) Library item preview thumbnail for bitmaps/symbols. The most critical is (1) and (2). See packages/authoring-ui/src/LibraryPanel.tsx (or Library.tsx), docs/07-symbols-and-library.md.
